data.title: Migrate imas-ambix per-plan pages to reckon format
data.phase: legacy field strip landed 2026-05-26; per-plan content authoring remaining
data.summary: Ambix-side migration from the pre-redesign markdown-and-mockdata format to the reckon state-JSON + SPA-page format. Depends on reckon/plans-infra (shipped). Phase 1 complete: legacy field strip surgery landed 2026-05-26 (commit a02d447) — five banned legacy fields (decisions_def, followups_done, dec_open, last, created) removed from all 16 per-plan JSONs in docs/state/imas-ambix/. Phase 2 remaining: per-plan content authoring — sections[] bodies, followup prompts, and rich body content for the 9 live plans.

sections.body: As of 2026-05-21, all 16 per-plan JSONs in docs/state/imas-ambix/ were written before the reckon schema was finalised. They carried five legacy fields in data{}: decisions_def (old open-choices array, pre-dates the decisions{} map), followups_done (resolved followups in a separate array; schema uses in-place resolved_at/resolved_by/outcome on the main followups[]), dec_open (counter field, now computed by the SPA from decisions{}), last (duplicate of last_modified; the canonical field is last_modified), created (creation timestamp not in the canonical schema). The reckon SPA did not read any of these fields and they were purely noise.

A single-pass Python surgery stripped the five banned fields from all 16 per-plan JSON files (skipping index.json and the newly-created plan-refactor-imas-ambix.json). The script also applied stub fix-ups for two phase-record artifacts: redesign-rollout.json (added title, summary, changed status from 'in-progress' to 'shipped') and tokenizers-12-landed.json (added title, summary, status='shipped' so the SPA can display the plan without crashing while preserving the four locked decisions as historical data). Commit: a02d447 in imas-ambix. The plan-refactor-imas-ambix.html page and its state JSON document the full scope. The chosen content-strategy decision was locked: option C — Hybrid (prototype shell + rich body).

Phase 2: author sections[] bodies for the 9 live plans (STRATEGY, v0-runway, compute, data-quality, tokenizers, tokenizer-benchmarks, world-model-v0, demo, and the redesign-rollout legacy page). The SPA's plan view reads sections[] for the rich body display; empty sections render as blank panels. Pilot on tokenizers (most decisions, most contentful), get user sign-off, then fleet Sonnets for the remaining 8. Per-stage frozen records (tokenizers-12-landed, redesign-rollout) stay as stub-only (content frozen). The mockdata-live-fetch decision is locked: live fetch from state JSON (not from a mockdata.js static file).

per-plan-content-strategy.choice: C — Hybrid: prototype shell + rich body
per-plan-content-strategy.rationale: make sure to update the skills for plan creation in dotfiles to permit this pattern

notes.body: This plan was originally authored in the reckon repo as reckon/plans-migration-ambix while the migration plans were incorrectly co-located. Moved to imas-ambix 2026-05-26 as this plan describes imas-ambix work. Cross-project dep on reckon/plans-infra dropped (that plan is shipped); noted in prose of summary instead.

followups.title: Pilot content-strategy C on tokenizers.html; get sign-off; fleet the other 8
followups.body: Tokenizers has the most going on: 4 active §12 decisions, rich body, history (per-stage tokenizers-12-landed). Pilot the chosen content-strategy (C — Hybrid) here, then fleet to the other 8 live plans. Per-stage record stays as restyle-only stub.
followups.prompt:
Project: imas-ambix
Plan:    plans-migration-ambix
Section: § 3 pilot
Tier:    opus (pilot); sonnet (fleet)

Context
  Legacy field strip landed 2026-05-26 (a02d447). Content strategy C — Hybrid
  is locked: prototype SPA shell + rich body sections[] in the JSON.
  mockdata-live-fetch is locked: live fetch from state JSON.
  Pilot the chosen approach on tokenizers.html (richest case). User signs off,
  then fleet sonnets for the other 8 live plans.

State to read
  docs/state/imas-ambix/plans-migration-ambix.json
  docs/state/imas-ambix/tokenizers.json

  per-plan-content-strategy → C — Hybrid: prototype shell + rich body
  mockdata-live-fetch → Live fetch from state JSON

Open decisions to surface (do not resolve unilaterally)
  (none on this plan — both decisions locked)

Done-when

  2. User signs off on the pilot.
  3. Fleet of sonnets migrates the remaining 8 live plans non-overlappingly.
  4. This followup resolved with outcome.
  5. New followup written: same recipe applied to efit; per-stage record handling confirmed.
